title: African Elephants in Tanzania
excerpt: African elephants live in close family groups led by a matriarch. Facts and the best places to see them in Tanzania.
body:
## Family

Herds are led by the oldest female, the matriarch. Males leave the herd as teenagers.

## Size

African savannah elephants are the largest land animals.

## Communication

They communicate with rumbles, some of them too low for humans to hear.

## Eating

An adult can eat well over 100 kg of food a day.

## Where in Tanzania

- [Tarangire](/blog/tarangire-national-park-guide/) in the dry season.
- Ruaha and Nyerere.
- The Serengeti.
- [West Kilimanjaro](/blog/west-kilimanjaro-safari/).

## Behaviour

Ears spread wide and a raised head can be a warning. Guides keep distance.

## Conservation

See [anti-poaching in Tanzania](/blog/anti-poaching-tanzania/). [Plan your safari](/travel-proposal/).
